items.title: File Einspruch against the prepayment assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter itself states the posting day as Saturday, 21.11.2026 ('Aufgabe zur Post Samstag, 21.11.2026') and that the Bescheid counts as bekannt gegeben on the 4th day after that posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO), i.e. Wednesday 25.11.2026. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Einspruch period starts the following day (26.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the same date number one month later: 25.12.2026. That day is Erster Weihnachtstag, a public holiday, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter says the posting day was Saturday, 21.11.2026, three days after the Bescheid's own date of 20.11.2026 (a Friday); this is unusual but not necessarily an error — if the person has proof the letter actually arrived later than the 4th-day rule assumes, the clause 'sofern er nicht nachweislich später eingegangen ist' means the Einspruch period would start later and the 28.12.2026 due date would move further out.

If the person's income from freelance translation has changed significantly since 2025, the letter invites a request to reduce the prepayments on presentation of a forecast ('Haben sich Ihre Einkünfte inzwischen deutlich verändert, können Sie unter Vorlage einer Prognose eine Anpassung beantragen') — this is an option, not a deadline, and no date is given for it.

The printed IBAN (DE39 4145 0075 0001 8002 00) is well-formed and its bank code matches 'Landesmusterbank' as printed, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership; this letter sets future quarterly prepayments rather than demanding an immediate transfer, so there is no urgent payment pressure, which is a good sign, but the account should still be checked against prior Finanzamt correspondence before any transfer.
